title: Broken Charter
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Broken Charter and the helm marks First Stamp. Do: Close on First Stamp. Two papers name the same hollow. Read the first stamp. The second stamp is the other body and the argument. Finish: come inside First Stamp's shell. The Charter writes standing. Planting starts the dispute. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
